purpose: Adopted whole-repository Rust source classification and no-growth size enforcement across the desktop shell, geometry/vectorize engines, MCP transport, accepted native feasibility proofs and staged native engine. Registration accompanies each new Rust-source candidate; counts are derived by the gate, not stored as current acceptance assertions.

scope.selection: Git candidate inventory via discoverRepositoryFiles (scripts/nemo/lib/boundaries-repository.cjs): all tracked paths plus non-ignored untracked paths, filtered to the .rs suffix. Selection is not a filesystem walk and applies no root, vendor or generated policy of its own.
scope.outsideSelection: Ignored build output is never a Git candidate, so generated Rust under */target/ is outside the selection rather than an exclusion. This is a reviewed consequence of the committed .gitignore, not a filename heuristic: no rule in this policy matches on the substring 'target'. At the candidate commit the working tree carried 5 generated .rs files under nemo-mcp/target/; that count is local build state and is deliberately not asserted as a repository fact. The regression test asserts the mechanism instead, on a purpose-built scratch repository.

discoveryReport.repositoryCandidatesNote: Historical snapshot measured on clean P07 candidate 7b87ccc. All counts in this provenance block describe that commit only; the gate independently discovers and classifies the current candidate without asserting these historical totals.

N08/#1340 registered native-engine/src/commands.rs, native-engine/src/request_receipts.rs, native-engine/src/revision.rs and native-engine/tests/commands.rs. N09/#1341 registered native-engine/src/history.rs, native-engine/src/transaction.rs and native-engine/tests/history.rs. N10/#1342 registered native-engine/src/evaluation.rs and native-engine/tests/evaluation.rs. N11/#1343 registered native-engine/src/resource_leases.rs, native-engine/src/scheduler.rs and native-engine/tests/scheduler.rs. N13/#1345 registers the staged desktop_viewport host and its test: it borrows N12 GPU resources through an injected SurfacePort, has no production Tauri binding, and fails closed until N16 proves the same-context surface seam. N14/#1346 registers native-engine/src/export_job.rs, native-engine/src/png_output.rs and native-engine/tests/export_job.rs for pinned-revision RGBA8 PNG sequence staging and publication. N15/#1347 registers native-engine/src/application.rs, native-engine/src/protocol.rs and native-engine/tests/application.rs for the staged common v2 dispatcher and opaque-resource transport. Every N07-N18A source uses the ordinary budget with zero exclusions or exceptions. The frozen baseline remains unchanged because these are newly adopted sources, not inherited debt.
provenance.lineCounter: countNonBlankLines (scripts/nemo/lib/boundaries.cjs) — the same counter the size checker uses, so recorded ceilings and enforced ceilings cannot drift.

relatedPolicies.reason: The MCP slice (nemo-mcp/** plus src-tauri/src/application_mcp.rs and its focused host test) additionally forbids size waivers entirely, asserted by tests/nemo-mcp-boundaries.test.cjs. P07/#1009 added nemo-mcp/src/capabilities.rs, nemo-mcp/src/capability_contract.rs and nemo-mcp/src/contract_tests.rs to both profiles together; N16/#1348 adds src-tauri/src/application_mcp_tests.rs to both. The overlay now declares 13 paths, all still declared here, and the regression test asserts the two profiles agree on the overlap so they cannot drift apart.

layerEnforcement.reason: Module.layer values in rust.profile.json are classification labels for this whole-tree source-size packet. Its own checks remain discovery, size and baseline comparison; adopted per-crate edge policies such as nemo-desktop.edges.json are enforced separately by the Rust-aware analyzer in scripts/nemo/lib/boundaries-rust.cjs. layerRules remains deliberately omitted here, and checkProfile is a JavaScript lexer that is never run against Rust source.

sizePolicy.singleProfileRationale: One ordinary budget covers production, test and build sources. Introducing a laxer test-specific budget here would define existing debt away instead of recording it; a future packet that actually reviews Rust test-size policy can add one, and compareSizeBaseline will surface it as size-baseline-new-profile if it exceeds the prior ordinary maximum.

retainedCeilings.note: nonblankLinesAtAdoption is the P11/#1013 adoption record and is deliberately not rewritten; nonblankLinesNow records the 106-line reduction P28/#1030 produced by moving the ffmpeg probe parser out to src-tauri/src/media_probe.rs, so the win stays visible instead of being erased. The ceiling stays at the adoption value: an extraction packet changes code, not size policy, and lowering the candidate ceiling without lowering the frozen baseline would give the baseline growth check 106 lines of slack.

exclusionsRationale: Every discovered Rust candidate, including feasibility proofs and staged native-engine modules, must be adopted into a module; no source is hidden through exclusions. An empty list is an assertion, not an omission: checkSourceCoverage reports coverage-unprofiled-source for any selected path that is neither declared nor exactly excluded, and the regression test exercises that failure.

integration.runsUnder: npm test and the test:unit job, which is in both the quick and full verify profiles — normal local validation, not an opt-in CLI.
requiredChecks: every discovered .rs is declared or exactly excluded
no declared .rs exceeds its effective ceiling
no effective ceiling grows against rust.baseline.json
negative fixtures leave the committed policy and its retained ceilings byte-identical
openGates: Whole-repository Cargo dependency/module-graph enforcement remains outside this source-size packet; adopted crate-local policies run separately.
Rust source is not wired into scripts/nemo/ci.cjs applicability; that file is shared and serialized.
